sancho-panza-cuba--linea-clasica.description: First registered in 1848, Sancho Panza takes its name from Don Quixote's loyal squire, one of several Habanos brands drawn from Spanish literature. Filler and binder come from the Vuelta Abajo and every size is long filler. Of medium strength, the Belicosos opens with black pepper and wood, finds earth and roasted coffee midway, and ends woody and firmer.

thirds.notes: A measured black-pepper start gives way to wood, with a dry, slightly bitter vegetal edge in some smokes.
Earth and roasted coffee join the wood in the smoothest, most rounded part of the cigar.
Wood takes over again as the strength rises, and the burn may need some attention.
